audit.scope: Original isolated main wing and flap, 90 mm span; car, supports and ground excluded.
audit.axes: CAD +X is flow, +Z is physical down, physical moments follow the right-hand rule.
audit.torque: Signed ideal input holding torque; full per-body force/moment virtual work. Gravity is added in the browser from the chosen moving mass.
audit.meshComparison: Absolute coarse-to-fine difference divided by the absolute fine value; sensitivity checks at the reference and folded poses.

cases.scope: Isolated original main wing and flap, unioned at the original overlapping hinge tabs; no car body, ground or supports.
cases.units: N, N m, m, rad; moments about world Y; physical up is -Z
cases.pressure_reference: Gauge pressure; farfield dynamic pressure 0 Pa
